name: ICRC receiving
brief: Field logisticians identify expected shipments, then scan a barcode, record received quantities, photograph damage evidence during review, and tag confirmation with current location, then confirm recipient details, and finally complete goods receipts offline with saved drafts and pending sync.

entities.description: A receiving session for one expected humanitarian shipment.
An expected shipment line whose delivered quantity and condition are recorded.
A local photograph documenting damage for one received shipment line.
The named recipient acknowledgement recorded before local completion.
A local queue entry that explains pending or failed synchronization.

pagination.boundedReason: A shipment receipt is capped at thirty lines in the prototype.
Each damaged line is capped at six local evidence photographs.

offlineIntent.notes: All receiving work remains local until connectivity returns.
offlineIntent.pendingSyncBehavior: Completed receipts remain visibly queued with their local timestamp and retry state.
offlineIntent.resumeBehavior: Saved drafts reopen at the last completed receiving stage with entered quantities intact.

scenarios.description: Two realistic expected shipments are available.
Expected receipts could not be loaded.
Saved receipt work remains available offline.
A damaged line and its local photograph require explicit discrepancy review.

criticalFlow.outcome: Complete a goods receipt locally with discrepancies and recipient acknowledgement preserved for synchronization.

productStructure.homeRationale: The expected-receipt queue is the permanent workspace because receivers start, resume, and monitor local receipts without opening the scanner first.
productStructure.launchRationale: A shift launches into the receipt queue so the receiver can choose expected work or resume a draft before requesting device permission.
productStructure.resumeRationale: Interrupted offline receiving resumes the first incomplete stage for the selected receipt while the queue remains the permanent return destination.

independentJobs.outcome: Choose and complete expected receiving work.
Review completed and failed-sync receipt history.

boundedFlows.outcome: Record, inspect, confirm, and complete one selected goods receipt.

intentionalEqualities.rationale: The queue is both the permanent hub and safest shift entry because it requires no selected receipt or device permission.
The first key-flow screen is also the concrete resume target because it restores the selected receipt at its first incomplete receiving stage.

items.purpose: Find the expected shipment and understand its current local receiving state.
items.outcome: Open the correct expected shipment without losing offline draft context.

firstViewport.focalPoint: The next expected shipment and any resumable local draft

qualityCriteria: The next receipt remains the single focal point.
Pending-sync status is never represented as an error.
Large text keeps receipt numbers and actions readable.

items.purpose: Scan and record delivered quantities and condition for each receipt line.
items.outcome: Every received line has a trustworthy quantity, condition, and optional barcode.

firstViewport.focalPoint: The current receipt line and quantity discrepancy

qualityCriteria: The scanner is optional and never replaces manual entry.
Quantity and condition remain visible above the action.
Pending writes disable repeat submission.

pagination.boundedReason: A shipment receipt is capped at thirty lines in the prototype.

items.purpose: Review received totals and discrepancies before recipient confirmation.
items.outcome: The logistician understands every short, damaged, or complete line before confirming.

firstViewport.focalPoint: The exact discrepancy count and affected lines

qualityCriteria: Discrepancies are distinguishable without color alone.
Expected and received totals remain paired.
Review cannot be skipped before confirmation.

pagination.boundedReason: A shipment receipt is capped at thirty lines in the prototype.
Each damaged line is capped at six local evidence photographs.

items.purpose: Capture recipient identity and acknowledgement after review.
items.outcome: A named recipient confirmation is saved locally against the correct receipt.

firstViewport.focalPoint: Recipient name, role, and explicit acknowledgement

qualityCriteria: Keyboard avoidance keeps the active field visible.
Confirmation is associated with the canonical receipt ID.
The save action is double-tap safe.

items.purpose: Complete the receipt locally and make pending synchronization explicit.
items.outcome: The locally complete receipt is safely queued and the user knows what happens next.

firstViewport.focalPoint: Local completion and pending synchronization state

qualityCriteria: Pending sync is not presented as failure.
Completion remains idempotent under repeated taps.
The receipt reference remains visible at large text sizes.

items.purpose: Revisit saved incomplete receipts across sessions.
items.outcome: Resume the exact local receipt stage and entered quantities.

firstViewport.focalPoint: The most recently saved receiving draft

qualityCriteria: Draft stage and receipt identity are both visible.
Offline drafts remain fully actionable.
Resume never creates a duplicate receipt.

items.purpose: Revisit completed and pending-sync receipts independently.
items.outcome: Understand local completion and synchronization history without reopening work.

firstViewport.focalPoint: Recent completed receipts and their synchronization state

qualityCriteria: Sync states have text labels in addition to color.
Failures show a recoverable next action.
History remains read-only and independently revisitable.

capabilitySelections.unavailableFallback: Keep manual barcode entry available beside the current receipt line.
capabilitySelections.deniedFallback: Keep the same line editor and focus the manual barcode field after denial.
capabilitySelections.failureBehavior: Preserve entered quantities and show a retry action without leaving the line.
capabilitySelections.offlineBehavior: Scan and manual values remain local with the receipt draft until synchronization.
capabilitySelections.rationale: Barcode capture accelerates line identification inside receiving while manual entry remains the reliable fallback.

capabilitySelections.unavailableFallback: Keep discrepancy review usable and allow a text evidence note for the damaged line.
capabilitySelections.deniedFallback: Keep the same review hierarchy and focus the text evidence fallback after denial.
capabilitySelections.failureBehavior: Preserve captured discrepancy details and allow an explicit photograph retry.
capabilitySelections.offlineBehavior: Store captured photographs as local evidence assets with the receipt draft.
capabilitySelections.rationale: Damage photography supports discrepancy review on demand and cannot replace the queue, receiving stages, or manual evidence fallback.

capabilitySelections.unavailableFallback: Continue recipient confirmation without a location tag and explain that omission.
capabilitySelections.deniedFallback: Keep confirmation usable and label location as not shared after permission denial.
capabilitySelections.failureBehavior: Preserve recipient details and allow one explicit location retry before completion.
capabilitySelections.offlineBehavior: Store a one-shot location tag locally with confirmation when the device provides it.
capabilitySelections.rationale: One-shot location supports receipt confirmation and never creates Home, reorders the journey, or requires continuous tracking.

designIntent.rationale: A dense field-work surface keeps the current receiving decision dominant while preserving offline confidence.

typographyIntent.character: compact utilitarian hierarchy with strong numeric legibility
typographyIntent.dynamicTypeBehavior: Reflow labels and quantities without truncating receipt references or actions.

colorBehavior.brandRole: Use the deep teal accent only for navigation and the single primary action.
colorBehavior.contrastIntent: All text and controls retain accessible contrast in light and dark host themes.

shapeAndElevation.shapeLanguage: Compact grouped rows and bounded input surfaces with restrained corner radius.
shapeAndElevation.elevationStrategy: Reserve elevation for the sticky action and modal confirmation, not ordinary sections.

mediaStrategy.role: Operational evidence is textual and scanner-assisted rather than decorative.
mediaStrategy.treatment: Keep camera output on demand and subordinate to line identity and quantity.
mediaStrategy.accessibility: Scanner results are repeated as readable text with a manual fallback.
mediaStrategy.connectivityRationale: Required operational evidence is captured or bundled locally so receipt work never depends on a network image.

signatureComponents.purpose: Keep capture mechanics and completion feedback unambiguous.
signatureComponents.responsiveBehavior: Stack context above progress labels at large Dynamic Type sizes.
signatureComponents.accessibilitySemantics: Expose the current receiving stage and completion value as one labelled progress group.

signatureComponents.purpose: Keep a reliable manual entry path beside on-demand barcode capture.
signatureComponents.responsiveBehavior: Keep the field and action in one reachable vertical group at large text sizes.
signatureComponents.accessibilitySemantics: Expose the field label, entered receipt reference, and submit action in logical order.

signatureComponents.purpose: Keep stage order and completion status visible through the receipt stages.
signatureComponents.responsiveBehavior: Wrap stage labels below their markers without horizontal scrolling.
signatureComponents.accessibilitySemantics: Announce stage position, completion state, and blocking reason in logical order.

signatureComponents.purpose: Make resumable local work distinct from completed history.
signatureComponents.responsiveBehavior: Keep receipt identity and resume action visible while metadata wraps.
signatureComponents.accessibilitySemantics: Each row exposes receipt reference, saved stage, time, and Resume action.

signatureComponents.purpose: Connect local completion events to pending or failed synchronization.
signatureComponents.responsiveBehavior: Collapse timeline metadata beneath the receipt reference at narrow widths.
signatureComponents.accessibilitySemantics: Expose completion time and synchronization state with text, not color alone.

stateTreatment.loading: Preserve receipt-row geometry with compact skeleton lines.
stateTreatment.empty: Keep warehouse context and offer the next valid recovery action.
stateTreatment.error: Use explicit error text and retry without replacing the workflow hierarchy.
stateTreatment.offline: Show saved-on-device status in the task context without warning styling.
stateTreatment.partialData: Show available receipt facts and identify fields awaiting local completion.
stateTreatment.success: Confirm local completion while retaining pending-sync state.
stateTreatment.permissionDenied: Keep manual barcode entry available when camera permission is denied.
stateTreatment.recovery: Return to the same receipt and stage with entered values intact.

principles: Use motion only for stage progression and save acknowledgement.
Keep scanner opening explicit and reversible.
motionIntent.reducedMotionBehavior: Replace progress transitions with immediate state changes while retaining status announcements.

accessibilityIntent.dynamicType: All labels and values reflow at large accessibility sizes.
accessibilityIntent.screenReader: Stage, discrepancy, and sync states expose explicit names, roles, values, and hints.
accessibilityIntent.focusOrder: Follow receipt context, task fields, state feedback, then the one primary action.
accessibilityIntent.modalFocus: Confirmation modals contain focus and restore it to the invoking receipt action.
accessibilityIntent.touchTargets: Every action and line control provides at least a 44-point target.
accessibilityIntent.contrast: Selection, warning, error, and completion remain distinguishable without color alone.
accessibilityIntent.keyboard: Dense form inputs remain visible and the sticky action stays reachable above the keyboard.
accessibilityIntent.safeArea: Headers, scanner controls, sticky actions, and tabs stay inside device safe areas.

revisitPatterns.evidence: The receipt queue is the repeated starting point for every shift.
Interrupted offline receipts must be resumed later.
Completed and failed-sync receipts are checked independently from active work.

evidence: Draft recovery and history are independent durable jobs.

tabsStackRecommendation.rationale: Three durable peer jobs require persistent switching while receipt stages stay nested.

assumptions: Fixture locations and organizations are fictional and used only for local prototype realism.
